potential_variance.title: Finite Haar variance and infinite potential cutoff
potential_variance.normalization: Var(Y_M)=(1/27)sum_{q=2}^M J2(q)*eta(q,M)^2; infinite variance uses full eta_q.

The exact lcm quotient is a GMP integer; its full residue table is not enumerated. Old floating variance is independently compared within its declared domain.
potential_variance.arithmetic: Exact finite Gram/Jordan variance V. The proved squared L2 cutoff error is E=256*(b+1)^2/M with 2*M<=2^b. Exact integer square roots give u>=0 with u^2>=V*E, rounded upward on a 1/M^2 grid. The full Haar variance lies in [V,V+2*u+E]. The same E bounds squared error of the full lcm-cylinder projection. No floating rounding supplies containment.

increment_covariance.title: Arithmetic and Ramanujan increment covariance

increment_covariance.arithmetic: Exact finite arithmetic and Ramanujan covariances, zero/one correlations and actual lcm return. With E the proved rational squared potential cutoff error, increment error squared is at most 4E. A rational u on grid 1/M^2 satisfies u^2>=finite_zero*4E; the full covariance lies within 2*u+4E of its finite value uniformly for all shifts. The full potential return error squared is at most 4E, and full covariance return loss lies in [0,8E]. No floating rounding supplies these conservative enclosures.

mass_inverse.title: Recovery of period masses from amplitudes
mass_inverse.normalization: v_k=sum_{j>=1} mu(j)*xi_(k*j), with absolute convergence from the Jordan condition.

mass_inverse.arithmetic: Exact finite inverse over multiples, distinct from reciprocal-budget inversion. Raw signed full-amplitude prefix intervals are expanded by E=4*(b_d+2*b_J+3)/(d^2*J), J=floor(Q/d), using minimal integers with 2*d<=2^b_d and 2*J<=2^b_J. The full mass lies in [max(0,beta_lower-E),beta_upper+E]. The target mass is not used to tighten its own recovery interval; all arithmetic is exact and the enclosure can be conservative.
